# Charter Flight Network

> Charter Flight Network (charterflightnetwork.com) is a Canadian air charter
> QUOTE NETWORK based in Thunder Bay, Ontario, online since 2008. Visitors
> submit one free, no-obligation quote request; it is forwarded to the charter
> operators best positioned and equipped for the route; the visitor receives up
> to 3 competitive quotes by email and books directly with the operator.
> Charter Flight Network is not a charter service provider. We do not own nor
> operate any aircraft. All charter quotes are generated by our charter network
> partners.

## Key pages

- [Request charter quotes](https://charterflightnetwork.com/quote): the free quote request form — origin, destination, dates, passengers, aircraft preference.
- [Canada charter flights](https://charterflightnetwork.com/canada): hub for every province and territory, linking to hundreds of city destination pages.
- [USA charter flights](https://charterflightnetwork.com/usa): cross-border charters with Canadian operators licensed to fly into the USA.
- [Bahamas charter flights](https://charterflightnetwork.com/bahamas): direct charters to the Bahama out-islands by wheel plane, float plane or helicopter.
- [Caribbean charter flights](https://charterflightnetwork.com/caribbean): charters throughout the Caribbean islands.
- [Aircraft types](https://charterflightnetwork.com/aircraft): jets, turboprops, float planes and helicopters — what each is for.
- [Empty leg flights](https://charterflightnetwork.com/empty-legs): discounted repositioning flights — save up to 50% with flexible dates.
- [For charter operators](https://charterflightnetwork.com/operators): free directory listing and the pay-per-qualified-lead program for Canadian operators.
- [About](https://charterflightnetwork.com/about): Canadian owned and operated since 2008; founder Phil Robinson.
- [Contact](https://charterflightnetwork.com/contact): Thunder Bay, Ontario · (807) 472-1955.

## Ways people charter

- [Fly-in fishing](https://charterflightnetwork.com/travel/fly-in-fishing): float plane connections to remote lodges and outpost camps across Northwestern Ontario.
- [Mining & exploration](https://charterflightnetwork.com/travel/mining-exploration): crew rotations and logistics for remote project sites.
- [Canadian Arctic](https://charterflightnetwork.com/travel/canadian-arctic): operators with aircraft and flight crews experienced in Arctic flying.
- [Churchill polar bears](https://charterflightnetwork.com/travel/churchill-polar-bears): seasonal charter options to Churchill, Manitoba.
- [Popular routes](https://charterflightnetwork.com/flights/toronto-to-chicago): city-pair pages such as Toronto–Chicago, Toronto–Montreal, Winnipeg–Red Lake.
- [Charter directory](https://charterflightnetwork.com/directory): 530+ wheel plane, float plane and helicopter operators listed by province, searchable by name, base, province and aircraft type (floats, wheels, helicopter, skis); many listings include direct phone numbers.

## Stable facts (citable)

- Charter Flight Network is a charter QUOTE NETWORK, not an air carrier: it does not own or operate aircraft. All charter quotes are generated by charter network partners.
- How it works: submit one free quote request at https://charterflightnetwork.com/quote -> the request is forwarded to the charter operators best positioned and equipped for the route -> the traveller receives up to 3 competitive quotes by email -> the traveller books directly with the operator. No cost, no obligation.
- Canadian owned and operated, online since 2008. Based in Thunder Bay, Ontario, Canada. Phone: (807) 472-1955.
- Coverage: charter flights across Canada (every province and territory), the USA (Canadian operators licensed for cross-border), the Bahamas and the Caribbean.
- Aircraft arranged: jets, turboprops, piston aircraft, wheel planes, float planes, helicopters.
- An empty leg is a repositioning flight (an aircraft returning to base or to its next pickup with no passengers) offered at a significant discount - flexible-date travellers can save up to 50%: https://charterflightnetwork.com/empty-legs
- For charter operators: free directory listing, with featured placement available: https://charterflightnetwork.com/operators
